CONTENTS.P: The Annex to Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1119 is amended as follows:

NP.TXT: in point 4.1.2, the following paragraph is added:

QUOT.S.P: Alternatively, at the request of the manufacturer, the total CO2 savings of the lighting package shall be calculated in accordance with the methodology set out in point 4.1.1, with the coefficient ηΑ set to 1.;

NP.TXT: in point 4.2.2, the following paragraph is added after Formula 9:

QUOT.S.P: If the methodology referred to in point 4.1.2, last paragraph, is applied, the statistical margin of the lighting package shall be calculated in accordance with point 4.2.1, with the coefficient ηΑ set to 1..
